integrity: No independent audit or mathematical validation; bibliographic priority remains subject to literature not indexed or accessible during this assessment.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the outer-independent 2-rainbow weight polynomial of triangular graphs with integer n >= 5; it does not treat unrestricted 2-rainbow functions or arbitrary line graphs. Finite checks do not replace the all-n proof. The minimum lower bound follows already from vertex cover; no priority claimed for that bound.
title: Outer-independent two-rainbow weight enumerator of triangular graphs
